metadata.chunk_title: Online Bachelor of Science in Design in Architectural Studies + Architecture: A job on the frontier of art and science

facts.value: Are you passionate about designing spaces that are visually engaging, functional, sustainable and culturally relevant? A Bachelor of Science in Design in architectural studies online from Arizona State University may be a good fit. You’ll graduate with a foundation in design principles, project-based experiences and the ability to contribute positively to the built environment and community.

metadata.chunk_title: Online Bachelor of Science in Design in Architectural Studies + Architecture: A job on the frontier of art and science

facts.value: Courses in this program offer a combination of theoretical concepts and project-based learning. You’ll develop foundational knowledge, as well as build practical skills in design thinking and principles, conceptualization, spatial awareness, architectural drawing and representation, digital tools, model making and more.
